title: The Proper way to do it
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：proper　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 proper 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the postman wrote of ① a proper way to do it in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so proper that nobody in the office would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the proper ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the proper way to do it that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for June 1954 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too proper to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the proper ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a proper answer for the office, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as proper as the answer for the office they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was proper or not, and he said so.

By 1967 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something proper, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite proper; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the proper ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1970, at once, she wrote of another proper way to do it in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less proper than anybody had expected. ⑩ The proper answer for the office that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1972, was the one she could never quite name; the proper ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 恰当（前置定语 a proper way to do it：1960 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件恰当的正当做法）
B. adj. 恰当／得体（两处加强说法：so proper that … 与 no less proper than …）
C. adj. 恰当／得体（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 恰当（表语 too proper to do：母亲觉得它太恰当，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 得体（前置定语 a proper answer for the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩得体的答复）
F. adj. 得体（同级比较 as proper as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩给办公室的得体答复相比）
G. adj. 得体（后置定语 something proper：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 得体（受程度副词修饰 quite proper：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a proper way to do it
the proper way to do it that
a proper answer for the office
The proper answer for the office that

answers.why: proper 意为“恰当”，1960 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件恰当的正当做法”，此处作前置定语 a proper way to do it。
proper 意为“恰当”，此处用 so proper that 结构，说它恰当到邮局里没人敢靠近。
proper 意为“恰当”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的恰当做这件事的正当做法，等于最高级的说法。
proper 意为“恰当”，母亲认为这件东西“太恰当了，谁也用不上”，too proper to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
proper 意为“得体”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩得体的答复”，此处作前置定语 a proper answer for the office。
proper 意为“得体”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩给办公室的得体答复一样得体”，同级比较用 as proper as。
proper 意为“得体”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“得体的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something proper。
proper 意为“得体”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当得体”，quite 修饰原级 proper。
proper 意为“得体”，no less proper than 表示“其得体不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之得体不亚于任何人的预料。
proper 意为“得体”，母亲 1972 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的得体答复”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1960 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件恰当的正当做法。（a proper way to do it）
它恰当到邮局里没有一个人敢靠近。（so proper that …）
母亲觉得它太恰当，谁也用不上。（too proper to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩得体的答复。（a proper answer for the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩给办公室的得体答复一样得体。（as proper as …）
到了 1967 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件得体的东西。（something proper）
answers: In 1960 the postman wrote of a proper way to do it in the list.
It was so proper that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too proper to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a proper answer for the office.
He said nobody would call it as proper as the answer for the office they had once had.
By 1967 the list asked for nothing but something proper.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 proper 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the postman wrote of a proper way to do it in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the proper way to do it that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too proper to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a proper answer for the office, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite proper, and everybody laughed.
The proper ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
